description: A prenex formula consists of a finite sequence of universal or existential quantifiers followed by a quantifier-free matrix; an empty prefix is allowed.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsPrenex.{u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'} {n : ℕ} :
  L.BoundedFormula α n → Prop
